name: Prohibition
overview: Scripture establishes clear prohibitions regarding the consumption of wine and strong drink for specific groups as a matter of obedience and holiness. Priests "on duty" are commanded not to drink wine or strong drink when entering the tabernacle, under penalty of death, emphasizing the seriousness of their service (Leviticus 10:9). Similarly, Nazarites are called to separate themselves from all products of the vine, including wine, vinegar, and grapes, for the duration of their vow, signifying a distinct consecration to God (Numbers 6:3-4). These restrictions highlight the importance of purity and dedication in roles set apart for God’s service.
